title: The Graphic Kahn–Kalai Conjecture
exact_target: Is there a universal $K>0$ such that, for every $H\subseteq K_n$, $p\geq Kp_E(H)\log v(H)$ implies $\Pr(G_{n,p}\supseteq H)\geq1/2$?
